audit_phase: FASE 20 — Cruzamento Completo Frontend (page.tsx) x Backend (routes.py)

defects_discovered_and_fixed.description: Catch-all SPA route returned HTTP 200 (index.html) for unmatched GET /api/* paths instead of JSON 404.
X-Tenant-Id header pointing to an unauthorized or non-existent tenant was silently ignored instead of raising HTTP 403 Forbidden.
Proposal PDF <a target='_blank'> link opened new browser tab without Bearer token or tenant_id query parameter, returning HTTP 401/404.
Public Landing Pages /lp/{slug} fell through to admin login SPA, lacked unauthenticated public lead capture endpoint, and needed explicit sanitize_text() XSS stripping on capture.
Menu 09 Piloto 7 Dias persisted history (/api/v1/system/pilot-7-days) was not loaded on initial dashboard boot.
